mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name AS courseName, c.semester, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.student_id) AS studentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.id) AS evaluationCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.score), 2), 0) AS avgScore FROM course c LEFT JOIN selection_record sr ON sr.course_id = c.id AND sr.status = 1 LEFT JOIN course_evaluation ce ON ce.course_id = c.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.semester ORDER BY c.id
